title: Tool 55 — DvP Reconciliation Engine
description: Three-pass delivery-versus-payment reconciliation for tokenized asset settlement. Match on-chain transfer events against off-chain cash ledger. Flags exceptions: delivered without payment, paid without delivery, timing mismatch, amount mismatch. Client-side. Zero PII.
